segments.contextAfter: `data`: Data appropriate for the callback type. For a `kCFSocketConnectCallBack` that failed in the background, it is a pointer to an `SInt32` error code; for a `kCFSocketAcceptCallBack`, it is a pointer to a [`CFSocketNativeHandle`](cfsocketnativehandle.md); or for a `kCFSocketDataCallBack`, it is a CFData object containing the incoming data. In all other cases, it is `NULL`.
